notes.title: 🚨Demo Update #5🚨
notes.content:
Hi 👋
Friends, we have another long-awaited update for the Hoglands 🐷 demo for you!

- We've redesigned the enemy combat system. Enemies no longer sneak into the base while ignoring barricades and security.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481772/741a5da540f94ddaf4ce20dea8b0c8baad735de9.png[/img]

- We added a second department to the workshop.
In the old part flamethrowers are made, and in the new part consumables are made - fuel and grenades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481772/1aa9e0ffb209a2ea193c81eb7880b8945bc883a1.png[/img]

- We added two new studies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481772/6d07442acbf0ce260a03bc4f2367c8d328f1d78b.png[/img]

- The duration of the demo version has been extended to 21 in-game days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481772/cf346bbfd5e31429a75e83800ef64e5857d2b078.png[/img]


We also made a lot of other small adjustments

We will be constantly updating and improving the demo.

That's all for now! If you have any questions or suggestions, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/YGUrYqg5Sy]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2210240]Steam community[/url]!

notes.title: 🚨Demo Update #4🚨
notes.content:
Hi 👋
Folks, we have another update for you!

- We have reworked the combat system. Now melee units attack enemies themselves when leaving the group, rather than waiting for orders from the player.
[previewyoutube=56iQEUTiPsM;full][/previewyoutube]

- The flamethrower has been redesigned. It now has a limited amount of fuel and must be recharged during battle using fuel capsules.
[previewyoutube=w41OiEeeB_E;full][/previewyoutube]

- Capsules with fuel can be bought in the workshop.
[previewyoutube=TQ6c0uGkJLA;full][/previewyoutube]

- Now, at night, graves will appear in the cemetery, from which zombies will periodically climb out.
[previewyoutube=QKiHjyxV4gY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
- They can be destroyed with the help of villagers or a flamethrower
[previewyoutube=_cOCvyCjKbo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] [previewyoutube=j9WLz2YtNoE;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]










- The crossbowman now takes longer to aim, but shoots more accurately.

We also made a lot of other small adjustments

We will be constantly updating and improving the demo.

That's all for now! If you have any questions or suggestions, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/wGTUprEYxG]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2210240]Steam community![/url]
